# pi-extensions

> Monorepo of independently installable Pi coding-agent extensions. Published packages use npm scope `@smarzban`; package READMEs are the user-facing source of truth.

## Start here

- [Root README](README.md): package directory and current npm availability
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md)
- [Development](docs/development.md)
- [Releases](docs/releases.md)

## Packages

- [pi-pacman](packages/pi-pacman/README.md): Pac-Man working indicator, npm `@smarzban/pi-pacman`
- [pi-statusline](packages/pi-statusline/README.md): custom footer statusline, npm `@smarzban/pi-statusline`
- [pi-toolview](packages/pi-toolview/README.md): compact built-in tool output, npm `@smarzban/pi-toolview`
- [pi-editor](packages/pi-editor/README.md): rounded editor and draft stash, npm `@smarzban/pi-editor` (source may be newer)
- [pi-usage](packages/pi-usage/README.md): local cross-harness token usage dashboard, source install currently
- [pi-spawn](packages/pi-spawn/README.md): confirmed named-agent fan-out and Herdr follow-ups, npm `@smarzban/pi-spawn`
